newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul bourse to open 30 minutes late on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul bourse to open 30 minutes late on Wednesday.

text.p: The Seoul stock market will open trading 30 minutes later than usual on Wednesday due to expected traffic jams as a result of first round of nationwide university entrance exams, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday.

The exchange said in a statement the morning session would open at 10:00 a.m. (0100 GMT), 30 minutes later than the usual opening time of 9:30 a.m. (0030 GMT) and also close 30 minutes later at 12:00 p.m. (0300 GMT).
He said the afternoon session trading would open 30 minutes later at 1:30 p.m. (0430 GMT) and close at 3:45 p.m. (0645 GMT).
